t2.thesis: CRWV enters earnings after a ~6% run-up on a Wayve deal, with a large implied move (~19%) and a history of selling off on prints, so the overnight gap is close to a coin flip with a slight negative tilt.
reasons: Stock rallied ~5-7% on the entry-eve day on a no-dollar-value deal and AI rebound, pulling some good news forward
Last 4 prints: only 1 of 4 gap-ups (win rate 25%), including two drops after EPS beats
Heavy leverage and funding concerns: a fresh $4.2B convertible, Microsoft backing away from neoclouds, and Cathie Wood's cost doubts
Strong fundamentals offset this: revenue +112%, backlog $104B plus $25B new commitments, and short interest of 22% leaves squeeze potential
Implied move of ~19% is large, so direction is nearly symmetric and the prior dominates
t2.deciding_variable: Forward guidance (Q4 revenue and capex) and financing and interest-cost commentary versus an elevated bar after the rebound.

prior.from: Overall buy-everything hit rate ~54.2% (validation); AMC 53.8%; ai_infra cluster 55.8% (n=43)

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. I don't have reliable information on how CRWV's stock moved after its 2026-11-10 earnings report, since that falls at or beyond what I can recall from memory.
t2.moved_from_prior: Down about 7 points from 0.54 to 0.47: the pre-earnings run-up, weak post-print history, and financing and customer-concentration worries outweigh the strong backlog and the squeeze potential from short interest.

theses.expected: Stock gaps down despite a revenue beat
theses.mechanism: Interest expense, capex and dilution worries dominate, and the run-up gets sold into
theses.wrong_if: Guidance and backlog surprise sharply higher and the stock opens up

theses.expected: Stock gaps up on a backlog and guidance beat
theses.mechanism: High short interest plus accelerating demand triggers a squeeze, and the Q2 reaction of +19.5% repeats

theses.expected: Muted or mixed open driven by AI-sector sentiment
theses.mechanism: Nvidia CEO news and macro moves dominate the overnight tape
theses.wrong_if: Company-specific numbers are far from consensus

key_observations: Full-year capex guide and any delays in data center availability
Backlog size, including new commitments beyond $129B
Interest expense and financing costs, adjusted operating margin
Customer concentration, including Microsoft and OpenAI commentary
